root_statement: All 14,122 formal result records carry l1_status=NOT_REACHED and l2_reachability_reason=L0_BLOCKED; the frozen adapter blocks before calling L1 or L2, so G6 has zero support and N_primary is necessarily zero.
subcause_evidence: ReadOnlyFrozenCertifierAdapter.evaluate writes L1/L2 NOT_REACHED with L0_BLOCKED whenever L0 is not PASS; the compact dependency count is 14,122/14,122.
subcause_limit: The single-scan compact outputs do not distinguish how many L0 results were FAIL versus UNKNOWN.
